packageRules.description: GitHub Actions stay SHA-pinned; update digest plus version comment together.
Node digest, pnpm and Dockerfile syntax are coupled build pins. Update deliberately with the image and locks.
Profile locks are generated by the Docker profile-locks target and must never be updated independently.
DSH is a developer preview. Every dependency update, including patch and digest updates, requires human review and manual merge.

prBodyNotes: DSH is a developer preview. Verify that the version change also updates the source commit, exact-hash patch anchors, locks, release tag and documentation. A version-only update is not mergeable.
